title: The Book of Acts Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Acts — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach,
verses.decoded: I have already written, O Theophilus, about everything Jesus began to do and teach,

verses.kjv: Until the day in which he was taken up, after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen:
verses.decoded: up until the day he was taken up to heaven, after giving instructions through the Holy Spirit to the apostles he had chosen,

verses.kjv: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:
verses.decoded: He also showed himself alive to them after his suffering by many convincing proofs. He appeared to them over a period of forty days and spoke about the kingdom of God.

verses.kjv: And, being assembled together with them, commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, saith he, ye have heard of me.
verses.decoded: While meeting with them, he ordered them not to leave Jerusalem but to wait for the Father's promise, which you have heard me talk about.

verses.kjv: For John truly baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence.
verses.decoded: John baptized with water, but soon you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.

verses.kjv: When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?
verses.decoded: When they were together, they asked him, 'Lord, are you going to restore the kingdom to Israel now?'

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father hath put in his own power.
verses.decoded: He replied, 'It is not for you to know the times or dates the Father has set by his own authority.'

verses.kjv: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
verses.decoded: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes on you, and you will be my witnesses in Jerusalem, throughout Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.

verses.kjv: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.
verses.decoded: After he said this, he was taken up before their eyes, and a cloud hid him from their sight.

verses.kjv: And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as he went up, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel;
verses.decoded: As they stared intently into the sky while he was going, two men dressed in white stood beside them.

verses.kjv: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.
verses.decoded: They said, 'Men of Galilee, why are you standing here looking into the sky? This same Jesus, who was taken from you into heaven, will come back in the same way you saw him go.'

verses.kjv: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day’s journey.
verses.decoded: Then the disciples returned to Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives, which is about a Sabbath day's walk from the city.

verses.kjv: And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas the brother of James.
verses.decoded: When they arrived, they went upstairs to a room where Peter, James, John, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas son of James were staying.

verses.kjv: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.
verses.decoded: All of them joined together constantly in prayer, along with the women, Mary the mother of Jesus, and his brothers.

verses.kjv: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples, and said, (the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty,)
verses.decoded: During this time, Peter stood among the believers—about 120 in all—and said,

verses.kjv: Men and brethren, this scripture must needs have been fulfilled, which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas, which was guide to them that took Jesus.
verses.decoded: Brothers, this scripture had to be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit spoke through David about Judas, who guided those who arrested Jesus.

verses.kjv: For he was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this ministry.
verses.decoded: For he was one of us and shared in our ministry.

verses.kjv: Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.
verses.decoded: This man bought a field with the money he got from doing wrong; then he fell headfirst, his body broke open, and his insides spilled out.

verses.kjv: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.
verses.decoded: Everyone living in Jerusalem knew about this, so that field became known by its original name, Aceldama, which means 'Field of Blood.'

verses.kjv: For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and his bishoprick let another take.
verses.decoded: Because it is written in the Psalms: 'Let his home be empty, and no one live there,' and 'Let someone else take his position.'

verses.kjv: Wherefore of these men which have companied with us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
verses.decoded: Therefore, from among these men who have been with us the whole time the Lord Jesus was with us,

verses.kjv: Beginning from the baptism of John, unto that same day that he was taken up from us, must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection.
verses.decoded: Starting from John’s baptism until the day Jesus was taken up, one of them must be chosen to be a witness of Jesus’ resurrection.

verses.kjv: And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.
verses.decoded: They nominated two men: Joseph called Barsabbas, also known as Justus, and Matthias.

verses.kjv: And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, which knowest the hearts of all men, shew whether of these two thou hast chosen,
verses.decoded: Then they prayed, saying, 'Lord, you know everyone’s heart; show us which of these two you have chosen,'

verses.kjv: That he may take part of this ministry and apostleship, from which Judas by transgression fell, that he might go to his own place.
verses.decoded: So that this person can take over the ministry and apostleship that Judas left when he sinned and went to his own place.

verses.kjv: And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.
verses.decoded: They cast lots, and the lot fell on Matthias, so he was added to the eleven apostles.

verses.kjv: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.
verses.decoded: When the day of Pentecost arrived, all of them were gathered together in one place, united in purpose.

verses.kjv: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
verses.decoded: Suddenly, a sound like a powerful, rushing wind came from heaven and filled the entire house where they were sitting.

verses.kjv: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them.
verses.decoded: What looked like divided tongues of fire appeared and rested on each of them.

verses.kjv: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
verses.decoded: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began speaking in different languages as the Spirit enabled them.

verses.kjv: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.
verses.decoded: At that time, there were devout Jewish people living in Jerusalem from every nation around the world.

verses.kjv: Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language.
verses.decoded: When the news spread, a crowd gathered and was amazed because each person heard them speaking in their own native language.

verses.kjv: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galilaeans?
verses.decoded: Everyone was amazed and asked each other, 'Aren't these people who are speaking all from Galilee?'

verses.kjv: And how hear we every man in our own tongue, wherein we were born?
verses.decoded: And how is it that we each hear them speaking in our own native language?

verses.kjv: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judaea, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,
verses.decoded: There were people from Parthia, Media, Elam, Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, and Asia,

verses.kjv: Phrygia, and Pamphylia, in Egypt, and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes,
verses.decoded: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, parts of Libya near Cyrene, and visitors from Rome—both Jews and converts to Judaism—

verses.kjv: Cretes and Arabians, we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God.
verses.decoded: Cretans and Arabs—we hear them speaking in our own languages about the amazing things God has done.

verses.kjv: And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying one to another, What meaneth this?
verses.decoded: Everyone was amazed and confused, asking each other, 'What does this mean?'

verses.kjv: Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.
verses.decoded: Some mocked and said, 'These men are drunk on new wine.'

verses.kjv: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judaea, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:
verses.decoded: But Peter stood up with the other eleven apostles, raised his voice, and said, 'Men of Judea and all who live in Jerusalem, listen carefully to what I say!'

verses.kjv: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is but the third hour of the day.
verses.decoded: They are not drunk as you think, since it is only nine o'clock in the morning.

verses.kjv: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel;
verses.decoded: But this is what the prophet Joel spoke about;

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God, I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:
verses.decoded: God says that in the last days, I will pour out my Spirit on everyone. Your sons and daughters will speak messages from God, your young men will see visions, and your old men will have dreams.

verses.kjv: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy:
verses.decoded: I will also pour out my Spirit on my male and female servants, and they will speak messages from God.

verses.kjv: And I will shew wonders in heaven above, and signs in the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke:
verses.decoded: I will show amazing signs in the sky and on the earth—things like blood, fire, and smoke.

verses.kjv: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before that great and notable day of the Lord come:
verses.decoded: Before that great and important day of the Lord arrives, the sun will turn dark and the moon will look like blood.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.
verses.decoded: And everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.

verses.kjv: Ye men of Israel, hear these words; Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as ye yourselves also know:
verses.decoded: Men of Israel, listen to me. Jesus of Nazareth was a man chosen by God, proven by the miracles, wonders, and signs God performed through him right here among you—you know this yourselves.

verses.kjv: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:
verses.decoded: Although God had planned it, you handed Jesus over and, with wicked hands, crucified and killed him.

verses.kjv: Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.
verses.decoded: But God raised him from the dead, freeing him from death’s power, because it was impossible for death to keep its hold on him.

verses.kjv: For David speaketh concerning him, I foresaw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:
verses.decoded: David said this about Jesus: I always saw the Lord in front of me; because he is at my right side, I will not be shaken.

verses.kjv: Therefore did my heart rejoice, and my tongue was glad; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope:
verses.decoded: So my heart was glad, my tongue rejoiced, and my body will rest in hope.

verses.kjv: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell, neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
verses.decoded: Because you will not abandon me to the grave, nor let your Holy One decay.

verses.kjv: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.
verses.decoded: You have shown me the path to life; you will fill me with joy by being near me.

verses.kjv: Men and brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us unto this day.
verses.decoded: Brothers, I can speak openly to you about David: he died and was buried, and his tomb is here with us today.

verses.kjv: Therefore being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne;
verses.decoded: David was a prophet and knew that God had promised him an oath that one of his descendants would be raised up to sit on his throne—the Messiah.

verses.kjv: He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ, that his soul was not left in hell, neither his flesh did see corruption.
verses.decoded: He foresaw this and spoke about Christ's resurrection, saying that his soul was not abandoned to the grave, nor did his body decay.

verses.kjv: This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses.
verses.decoded: God has raised this Jesus from the dead, and we are all witnesses of this fact.

verses.kjv: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted, and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost, he hath shed forth this, which ye now see and hear.
verses.decoded: So, Jesus has been exalted to God's right hand and has received the promised Holy Spirit from the Father, which is what you are now seeing and hearing.

verses.kjv: For David is not ascended into the heavens: but he saith himself, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
verses.decoded: David did not go up to heaven, but he said himself, 'The Lord said to my Lord, Sit at my right hand,'

verses.kjv: Until I make thy foes thy footstool.
verses.decoded: Until I make your enemies a footstool under your feet.

verses.kjv: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made that same Jesus, whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.
verses.decoded: So, let all Israel be certain that God has made Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Messiah.

verses.kjv: Now when they heard this, they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men and brethren, what shall we do?
verses.decoded: When they heard this, they felt deep conviction and asked Peter and the other apostles, 'Brothers, what should we do?'

verses.kjv: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.
verses.decoded: Peter replied, 'Turn away from your sins and be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.'

verses.kjv: For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the LORD our God shall call.
verses.decoded: This promise is for you, your children, and everyone far away—everyone whom the Lord our God calls.

verses.kjv: And with many other words did he testify and exhort, saying, Save yourselves from this untoward generation.
verses.decoded: Peter continued to speak strongly, urging them to save themselves from this corrupt generation.

verses.kjv: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized: and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls.
verses.decoded: Those who accepted his message were baptized, and about three thousand people were added that day.

verses.kjv: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles’ doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.
verses.decoded: They devoted themselves to the apostles' teaching, to fellowship, to sharing meals, and to prayer.

verses.kjv: And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles.
verses.decoded: A sense of awe came over everyone, and the apostles performed many miraculous signs.

verses.kjv: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;
verses.decoded: All the believers stayed united and shared everything they had.

verses.kjv: And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men, as every man had need.
verses.decoded: They sold their possessions and goods and distributed the proceeds to anyone in need.

verses.kjv: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart,
verses.decoded: Every day, they stayed united in the temple and shared meals together in their homes, eating with joy and sincere hearts.

verses.kjv: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.
verses.decoded: They praised God and were well liked by everyone. The Lord kept adding new believers to their group every day.

verses.kjv: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour.
verses.decoded: Peter and John went to the temple together at the time of prayer, which was about 3 p.m.

verses.kjv: And a certain man lame from his mother’s womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;
verses.decoded: There was a man who had been lame since birth. People carried him every day and placed him at the Beautiful Gate of the temple to beg from those entering.

verses.kjv: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms.
verses.decoded: When he saw Peter and John going into the temple, he asked them for money.

verses.kjv: And Peter, fastening his eyes upon him with John, said, Look on us.
verses.decoded: Peter looked directly at him, along with John, and said, 'Look at us.'

verses.kjv: And he gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something of them.
verses.decoded: The man looked at them, expecting to get some money.

verses.kjv: Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.
verses.decoded: Peter said, 'I don’t have any silver or gold, but I will give you what I have: In the name of Jesus Christ from Nazareth, stand up and walk.'

verses.kjv: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength.
verses.decoded: Peter took the man’s right hand and helped him up. Immediately, the man’s feet and ankles became strong.

verses.kjv: And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.
verses.decoded: The man jumped up, stood, and began walking. He went into the temple with them, walking, jumping, and praising God.

verses.kjv: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:
verses.decoded: Everyone saw him walking and praising God.

verses.kjv: And they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple: and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him.
verses.decoded: They recognized him as the man who used to beg at the Beautiful Gate, and they were amazed at what had happened to him.

verses.kjv: And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.
verses.decoded: As the healed man held onto Peter and John, a crowd gathered around them in Solomon’s Colonnade, full of amazement.

verses.kjv: And when Peter saw it, he answered unto the people, Ye men of Israel, why marvel ye at this? or why look ye so earnestly on us, as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk?
verses.decoded: When Peter saw this, he said to the people, 'Men of Israel, why are you amazed? Why do you stare at us as if we made this man walk by our own power or godliness?'

verses.kjv: The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, hath glorified his Son Jesus; whom ye delivered up, and denied him in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let him go.
verses.decoded: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—the God of our ancestors—has glorified His servant Jesus. You handed Him over and rejected Him before Pilate, even though Pilate wanted to release Him.

verses.kjv: But ye denied the Holy One and the Just, and desired a murderer to be granted unto you;
verses.decoded: But you rejected the Holy and Righteous One and asked for a murderer to be released instead.

verses.kjv: And killed the Prince of life, whom God hath raised from the dead; whereof we are witnesses.
verses.decoded: You killed the Author of life, but God raised Him from the dead—and we are witnesses of this.

verses.kjv: And his name through faith in his name hath made this man strong, whom ye see and know: yea, the faith which is by him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.
verses.decoded: It is by faith in the name of Jesus that this man, whom you all know, has been healed completely and made strong right before your eyes.

verses.kjv: And now, brethren, I wot that through ignorance ye did it, as did also your rulers.
verses.decoded: Brothers, I know that you and your leaders acted out of ignorance when you did this.

verses.kjv: But those things, which God before had shewed by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he hath so fulfilled.
verses.decoded: But God fulfilled what He had foretold through all the prophets—that the Messiah would suffer.

verses.kjv: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
verses.decoded: So turn away from your sins and change your hearts, so that your sins may be wiped away when God sends a time of renewal.

verses.kjv: And he shall send Jesus Christ, which before was preached unto you:
verses.decoded: God will send Jesus Christ back to you, the same one you heard about before.

verses.kjv: Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.
verses.decoded: Heaven must keep Jesus until the time comes to restore everything as God promised through His holy prophets from ancient times.

verses.kjv: For Moses truly said unto the fathers, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you.
verses.decoded: Moses told your ancestors that God would raise up a prophet like him from among your people, and you must listen to everything he says.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that every soul, which will not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed from among the people.
verses.decoded: Anyone who refuses to listen to that prophet will be cut off from the people.

verses.kjv: Yea, and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after, as many as have spoken, have likewise foretold of these days.
verses.decoded: In fact, all the prophets from Samuel onward have predicted these times.

verses.kjv: Ye are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.
verses.decoded: You are the descendants of the prophets and part of the covenant God made with our ancestors, promising Abraham that through his offspring all nations would be blessed.

verses.kjv: Unto you first God, having raised up his Son Jesus, sent him to bless you, in turning away every one of you from his iniquities.
verses.decoded: God raised up His Son Jesus and sent Him to bless you first by turning each of you away from your sins.

verses.kjv: And as they spake unto the people, the priests, and the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees, came upon them,
verses.decoded: While they were speaking to the people, the priests, the temple captain, and the Sadducees came to them.

verses.kjv: Being grieved that they taught the people, and preached through Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
verses.decoded: They were upset because Peter and John were teaching the people and preaching about Jesus' resurrection from the dead.

verses.kjv: And they laid hands on them, and put them in hold unto the next day: for it was now eventide.
verses.decoded: They arrested them and kept them in custody until the next day, because it was already evening.

verses.kjv: Howbeit many of them which heard the word believed; and the number of the men was about five thousand.
verses.decoded: However, many who heard the message believed, and there were about five thousand men.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that their rulers, and elders, and scribes,
verses.decoded: The next day, the rulers, elders, and teachers of the law

verses.kjv: And Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest, were gathered together at Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Annas the high priest, Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and others related to the high priest gathered in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power, or by what name, have ye done this?
verses.decoded: They placed Peter and John in the center and asked, 'By what power or in whose name have you done this?'

verses.kjv: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Ghost, said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,
verses.decoded: Filled with the Holy Spirit, Peter said to them, 'Leaders of the people and elders of Israel,'

verses.kjv: If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man, by what means he is made whole;
verses.decoded: If you are questioning us today about the healing of this disabled man, and how he was made well;

verses.kjv: Be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, even by him doth this man stand here before you whole.
verses.decoded: Know this, all of you and all the people of Israel: It is by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth—whom you crucified but whom God raised from the dead—that this man stands healed before you.

verses.kjv: This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders, which is become the head of the corner.
verses.decoded: He is the stone you builders rejected, which has now become the cornerstone.

verses.kjv: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.
verses.decoded: Salvation is found in no one else, because no other name under heaven has been given to people by which we must be saved.

verses.kjv: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.
verses.decoded: When they saw how bold Peter and John were, and realized they were ordinary, uneducated men, they were amazed and recognized that they had been with Jesus.

verses.kjv: And beholding the man which was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.
verses.decoded: Seeing the man who had been healed standing with them, they had no argument against it.

verses.kjv: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,
verses.decoded: After ordering them to leave the council, they met together to discuss the matter.

verses.kjv: Saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny it.
verses.decoded: They said, 'What should we do with these men? Everyone living in Jerusalem knows a remarkable miracle was done through them, and we cannot deny it.'

verses.kjv: But that it spread no further among the people, let us straitly threaten them, that they speak henceforth to no man in this name.
verses.decoded: But to stop this from spreading among the people, let's strongly warn them not to speak to anyone anymore in Jesus' name.

verses.kjv: And they called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.
verses.decoded: They summoned Peter and John and ordered them not to speak or teach at all in Jesus' name.

verses.kjv: But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye.
verses.decoded: But Peter and John replied, 'You decide if it is right before God to obey you rather than God.'

verses.kjv: For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.
verses.decoded: We cannot stop telling what we have seen and heard.

verses.kjv: So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding nothing how they might punish them, because of the people: for all men glorified God for that which was done.
verses.decoded: After threatening them more, they released them because they couldn't find a way to punish them, since everyone was praising God for what happened.

verses.kjv: For the man was above forty years old, on whom this miracle of healing was shewed.
verses.decoded: The man who was healed was over forty years old.

verses.kjv: And being let go, they went to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said unto them.
verses.decoded: Once released, they returned to their group and told them everything the chief priests and elders had said.

verses.kjv: And when they heard that, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, Lord, thou art God, which hast made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all that in them is:
verses.decoded: When they heard this, they all prayed together, saying, 'Lord, you are God, the Creator of heaven, earth, the sea, and everything in them.'

verses.kjv: Who by the mouth of thy servant David hast said, Why did the heathen rage, and the people imagine vain things?
verses.decoded: You said through your servant David, 'Why do the nations rage and people plan useless things?'

verses.kjv: The kings of the earth stood up, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord, and against his Christ.
verses.decoded: The kings and rulers of the earth have gathered together against the Lord and His Anointed One.

verses.kjv: For of a truth against thy holy child Jesus, whom thou hast anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the people of Israel, were gathered together,
verses.decoded: Indeed, Herod, Pontius Pilate, the Gentiles, and the people of Israel all came together against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed.

verses.kjv: For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done.
verses.decoded: But they did all this to carry out what your hand and plan had decided beforehand.

verses.kjv: And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants, that with all boldness they may speak thy word,
verses.decoded: Now, Lord, look at their threats. Please give your servants boldness to speak your message fearlessly.

verses.kjv: By stretching forth thine hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done by the name of thy holy child Jesus.
verses.decoded: By using your power to heal and perform miracles through the name of your holy servant Jesus.

verses.kjv: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.
verses.decoded: After they prayed, the place where they were meeting shook, and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit. They spoke God's message confidently.

verses.kjv: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.
verses.decoded: All the believers were united in heart and mind. No one claimed personal ownership of their possessions; instead, they shared everything.

verses.kjv: And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all.
verses.decoded: The apostles boldly testified about Jesus’ resurrection, and God’s favor was with all of them.

verses.kjv: Neither was there any among them that lacked: for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the prices of the things that were sold,
verses.decoded: No one among them was in need because those who owned land or houses sold them

verses.kjv: And laid them down at the apostles’ feet: and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need.
verses.decoded: and brought the money to the apostles, who distributed it to each person according to their needs.

verses.kjv: And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,) a Levite, and of the country of Cyprus,
verses.decoded: There was a man named Joses, whom the apostles called Barnabas, meaning 'Son of Encouragement.' He was a Levite from Cyprus.

verses.kjv: Having land, sold it, and brought the money, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
verses.decoded: He owned land, sold it, and brought the money to the apostles to distribute.

verses.kjv: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,
verses.decoded: A man named Ananias and his wife Sapphira sold a piece of property,

verses.kjv: And kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
verses.decoded: but they kept part of the money for themselves, with his wife knowing about it, and only brought a portion to the apostles and placed it at their feet.

verses.kjv: But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost, and to keep back part of the price of the land?
verses.decoded: Then Peter said, 'Ananias, why has Satan made you lie to the Holy Spirit and keep back part of the money from the land sale?'

verses.kjv: Whiles it remained, was it not thine own? and after it was sold, was it not in thine own power? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart? thou hast not lied unto men, but unto God.
verses.decoded: 'While you still had it, wasn’t it yours? And after selling it, wasn’t the money still yours? Why did you decide to do this in your heart? You haven’t lied to people, but to God.'

verses.kjv: And Ananias hearing these words fell down, and gave up the ghost: and great fear came on all them that heard these things.
verses.decoded: When Ananias heard this, he fell down and died. Everyone who heard about it was filled with great fear.

verses.kjv: And the young men arose, wound him up, and carried him out, and buried him.
verses.decoded: Some young men got up, wrapped him in a cloth, carried him out, and buried him.

verses.kjv: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.
verses.decoded: About three hours later, his wife came in, not knowing what had happened.

verses.kjv: And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much? And she said, Yea, for so much.
verses.decoded: Peter asked her, 'Tell me, did you sell the land for this amount?' She said, 'Yes, that’s the price.'

verses.kjv: Then Peter said unto her, How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them which have buried thy husband are at the door, and shall carry thee out.
verses.decoded: Peter said, 'Why have you both agreed to test the Spirit of the Lord? The men who buried your husband are at the door and will carry you out too.'

verses.kjv: Then fell she down straightway at his feet, and yielded up the ghost: and the young men came in, and found her dead, and, carrying her forth, buried her by her husband.
verses.decoded: Immediately she fell down at his feet and died. The young men came in, found her dead, carried her out, and buried her beside her husband.

verses.kjv: And great fear came upon all the church, and upon as many as heard these things.
verses.decoded: Great fear spread throughout the whole church and among everyone who heard what happened.

verses.kjv: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.
verses.decoded: The apostles performed many miraculous signs and wonders among the people, and all the believers met together in Solomon’s Colonnade.

verses.kjv: And of the rest durst no man join himself to them: but the people magnified them.
verses.decoded: No one else dared to join them openly, but the people praised them highly.

verses.kjv: And believers were the more added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women.)
verses.decoded: More and more people believed and were added to the Lord, including many men and women.

verses.kjv: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.
verses.decoded: People brought the sick out into the streets and laid them on beds and mats, hoping that at least Peter’s shadow passing by would heal some of them.

verses.kjv: There came also a multitude out of the cities round about unto Jerusalem, bringing sick folks, and them which were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed every one.
verses.decoded: People from many nearby towns came to Jerusalem, bringing sick people and those troubled by evil spirits, and everyone was healed.

verses.kjv: Then the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him, (which is the sect of the Sadducees,) and were filled with indignation,
verses.decoded: The high priest and the Sadducees with him became very angry and jealous.

verses.kjv: And laid their hands on the apostles, and put them in the common prison.
verses.decoded: They arrested the apostles and put them in the public jail.

verses.kjv: But the angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors, and brought them forth, and said,
verses.decoded: But during the night, an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors, led them out, and said,

verses.kjv: Go, stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.
verses.decoded: Go and stand in the temple and tell the people all about the message of life.

verses.kjv: And when they heard that, they entered into the temple early in the morning, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.
verses.decoded: When the apostles heard this, they went to the temple early and taught. The high priest and his associates gathered the council and senate and sent for the apostles to be brought from prison.

verses.kjv: But when the officers came, and found them not in the prison, they returned, and told,
verses.decoded: But when the officers arrived, they found the apostles were not in the prison, so they returned and reported this.

verses.kjv: Saying, The prison truly found we shut with all safety, and the keepers standing without before the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.
verses.decoded: They said, 'The prison was securely locked and the guards were standing outside, but when we opened it, no one was inside.'

verses.kjv: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things, they doubted of them whereunto this would grow.
verses.decoded: When the high priest, temple captain, and chief priests heard this, they were uncertain what would happen next.

verses.kjv: Then came one and told them, saying, Behold, the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple, and teaching the people.
verses.decoded: Someone came and told them, 'The men you put in prison are now standing in the temple teaching the people.'

verses.kjv: Then went the captain with the officers, and brought them without violence: for they feared the people, lest they should have been stoned.
verses.decoded: The captain and officers went and brought the apostles without using force because they feared the people might stone them.

verses.kjv: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council: and the high priest asked them,
verses.decoded: After bringing them, they stood the apostles before the council, and the high priest questioned them.

verses.kjv: Saying, Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name? and, behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man’s blood upon us.
verses.decoded: He said, 'Didn’t we strictly order you not to teach in this name? Yet you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching and want to bring the guilt of this man’s death on us.'

verses.kjv: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.
verses.decoded: Peter and the other apostles replied, 'We must obey God rather than human authorities.'

verses.kjv: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom ye slew and hanged on a tree.
verses.decoded: The God of our ancestors raised Jesus from the dead, the same Jesus you killed by hanging him on a tree.

verses.kjv: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.
verses.decoded: God has raised him to a position of highest honor and power to be a leader and Savior, to give Israel the chance to turn from sin and receive forgiveness.

verses.kjv: And we are his witnesses of these things; and so is also the Holy Ghost, whom God hath given to them that obey him.
verses.decoded: We are witnesses to these facts, and so is the Holy Spirit, whom God gives to those who obey him.

verses.kjv: When they heard that, they were cut to the heart, and took counsel to slay them.
verses.decoded: When they heard this, they were deeply disturbed and planned to kill the apostles.

verses.kjv: Then stood there up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people, and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space;
verses.decoded: Then a respected Pharisee and teacher of the law named Gamaliel stood up in the council and ordered that the apostles be taken outside for a short time.

verses.kjv: And said unto them, Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men.
verses.decoded: He said to them, 'Men of Israel, be careful about what you plan to do with these men.'

verses.kjv: For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought.
verses.decoded: Before this, a man named Theudas appeared, claiming to be important; about four hundred people followed him, but he was killed, and his followers were scattered and destroyed.

verses.kjv: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.
verses.decoded: After him, Judas of Galilee led a revolt during the census and attracted many followers; he also died, and his followers were scattered.

verses.kjv: And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nought:
verses.decoded: So I advise you to leave these men alone. If their plan or work is merely human, it will fail on its own.

verses.kjv: But if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.
verses.decoded: But if it comes from God, you will not be able to stop it, and you might even find yourselves fighting against God.

verses.kjv: And to him they agreed: and when they had called the apostles, and beaten them, they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
verses.decoded: The council agreed with him. They called the apostles, whipped them, ordered them not to speak in Jesus' name, and then released them.

verses.kjv: And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.
verses.decoded: The apostles left the council happy because they were considered worthy to suffer disgrace for Jesus' name.

verses.kjv: And daily in the temple, and in every house, they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ.
verses.decoded: Every day, both in the temple and in people's homes, they continued teaching and preaching about Jesus Christ without stopping.

verses.kjv: And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.
verses.decoded: At that time, as the number of believers was growing, the Greek-speaking Jews complained against the Hebrew-speaking Jews because their widows were being overlooked in the daily distribution of food.

verses.kjv: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them, and said, It is not reason that we should leave the word of God, and serve tables.
verses.decoded: The twelve apostles gathered all the believers and said, 'It wouldn't be right for us to stop preaching God's word just to serve food and manage daily tasks.'

verses.kjv: Wherefore, brethren, look ye out among you seven men of honest report, full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.
verses.decoded: So, brothers and sisters, choose seven trustworthy men from among you who are full of the Holy Spirit and wisdom, so we can put them in charge of this work.

verses.kjv: But we will give ourselves continually to prayer, and to the ministry of the word.
verses.decoded: Meanwhile, we will keep focusing on prayer and preaching God's message.

verses.kjv: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch:
verses.decoded: The proposal pleased everyone, so they selected Stephen, a man full of faith and the Holy Spirit, along with Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas, a convert from Antioch.

verses.kjv: Whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.
verses.decoded: They brought these men to the apostles, who prayed and laid their hands on them to officially appoint them.

verses.kjv: And the word of God increased; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.
verses.decoded: As a result, God's message spread, many more believers joined in Jerusalem, and even many priests became followers of the faith.

verses.kjv: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.
verses.decoded: Stephen, full of faith and God's power, performed amazing miracles and signs among the people.

verses.kjv: Then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called the synagogue of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and of Asia, disputing with Stephen.
verses.decoded: Some men from various synagogues—those of the Libertines, Cyrenians, Alexandrians, and others from Cilicia and Asia—began arguing with Stephen.

verses.kjv: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake.
verses.decoded: But they could not stand up against the wisdom and the Spirit with which Stephen spoke.

verses.kjv: Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and against God.
verses.decoded: So they bribed some men to falsely accuse Stephen, saying, 'We heard him say blasphemous things against Moses and God.'

verses.kjv: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him, and caught him, and brought him to the council,
verses.decoded: They stirred up the crowd, the elders, and the teachers of the law; they seized Stephen and brought him before the council.

verses.kjv: And set up false witnesses, which said, This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law:
verses.decoded: False witnesses were brought forward, claiming, 'This man never stops saying offensive things against this holy place and the law.'

verses.kjv: For we have heard him say, that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us.
verses.decoded: They said, 'We heard him say that Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs Moses gave us.'

verses.kjv: And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.
verses.decoded: Everyone sitting on the council stared at Stephen, and they saw his face shining like the face of an angel.

verses.kjv: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?
verses.decoded: Then the high priest asked, 'Is this true?'

verses.kjv: And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran,
verses.decoded: Stephen said, 'Men, brothers, and fathers, listen: The glorious God appeared to our ancestor Abraham while he was living in Mesopotamia, before he settled in Haran.'

verses.kjv: And said unto him, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and come into the land which I shall shew thee.
verses.decoded: God told him, 'Leave your country and your family, and go to the land I will show you.'

verses.kjv: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and dwelt in Charran: and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein ye now dwell.
verses.decoded: So Abraham left the land of the Chaldeans and lived in Haran. After his father died, God moved him to this land where you now live.

verses.kjv: And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.
verses.decoded: God did not give Abraham any land to own—not even a place to set his foot—but He promised to give it to him and his descendants, even though Abraham had no children yet.

verses.kjv: And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.
verses.decoded: God said that Abraham’s descendants would live as foreigners in another land, where they would be enslaved and mistreated for 400 years.

verses.kjv: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.
verses.decoded: God said He would punish the nation that enslaves them, and afterward, His people would come out and worship Him here.

verses.kjv: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so Abraham begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs.
verses.decoded: God made a covenant of circumcision with Abraham. Abraham had Isaac and circumcised him on the eighth day. Isaac had Jacob, and Jacob had the twelve patriarchs.

verses.kjv: And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him,
verses.decoded: The patriarchs, jealous of Joseph, sold him into Egypt, but God was with him.

verses.kjv: And delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
verses.decoded: God rescued Joseph from all his troubles and gave him favor and wisdom with Pharaoh, who made him ruler over Egypt and his entire household.

verses.kjv: Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Chanaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.
verses.decoded: There was a famine throughout Egypt and Canaan, and our ancestors had no food to survive.

verses.kjv: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.
verses.decoded: When Jacob heard there was grain in Egypt, he sent our ancestors there first.

verses.kjv: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph’s kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.
verses.decoded: On the second visit, Joseph revealed himself to his brothers, and his family was introduced to Pharaoh.

verses.kjv: Then sent Joseph, and called his father Jacob to him, and all his kindred, threescore and fifteen souls.
verses.decoded: Joseph sent for his father Jacob and all his relatives—seventy-five people in total.

verses.kjv: So Jacob went down into Egypt, and died, he, and our fathers,
verses.decoded: Jacob went to Egypt and died there, along with our ancestors.

verses.kjv: And were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem.
verses.decoded: They were taken to Shechem and buried in the tomb that Abraham bought from the sons of Hamor, the father of Shechem, for a price.

verses.kjv: But when the time of the promise drew nigh, which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,
verses.decoded: But when the time God had promised to Abraham was coming, the people of Israel increased greatly in Egypt.

verses.kjv: Till another king arose, which knew not Joseph.
verses.decoded: Then a new king came to power who did not know about Joseph.

verses.kjv: The same dealt subtilly with our kindred, and evil entreated our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live.
verses.decoded: This king treated our people cruelly and forced our ancestors to abandon their newborn children so they would die.

verses.kjv: In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his father’s house three months:
verses.decoded: During this time, Moses was born and was a beautiful child. He was cared for in his own family for three months.

verses.kjv: And when he was cast out, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.
verses.decoded: When he was put out, Pharaoh’s daughter found him and raised him as her own son.

verses.kjv: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.
verses.decoded: Moses was educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians and became powerful in speech and action.

verses.kjv: And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: When Moses was forty years old, he decided to visit his fellow Israelites.

verses.kjv: And seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him that was oppressed, and smote the Egyptian:
verses.decoded: He saw an Israelite being mistreated, so he defended him, punished the oppressor, and killed the Egyptian.

verses.kjv: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.
verses.decoded: He thought his people would realize that God was using him to save them, but they did not understand.

verses.kjv: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove, and would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, ye are brethren; why do ye wrong one to another?
verses.decoded: The next day, Moses came to them while they were fighting and tried to stop them, saying, 'Men, you are brothers; why are you hurting each other?'

verses.kjv: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us?
verses.decoded: But the one who was wronging his neighbor pushed Moses away and said, 'Who made you our leader and judge?'

verses.kjv: Wilt thou kill me, as thou diddest the Egyptian yesterday?
verses.decoded: Are you going to kill me like you killed the Egyptian yesterday?

verses.kjv: Then fled Moses at this saying, and was a stranger in the land of Madian, where he begat two sons.
verses.decoded: So Moses ran away and lived as a foreigner in Midian, where he had two sons.

verses.kjv: And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sina an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.
verses.decoded: After forty years, an angel of the Lord appeared to Moses in the wilderness on Mount Sinai, in a burning bush that was not consumed.

verses.kjv: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold it, the voice of the LORD came unto him,
verses.decoded: When Moses saw it, he was amazed. As he came closer to look, the Lord’s voice spoke to him,

verses.kjv: Saying, I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.
verses.decoded: Saying, 'I am the God of your ancestors—the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.' Moses was afraid and didn’t dare to look directly.

verses.kjv: Then said the Lord to him, Put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.
verses.decoded: Then the Lord told him, 'Take off your sandals, because you are standing on holy ground.'

verses.kjv: I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send thee into Egypt.
verses.decoded: I have seen the suffering of my people in Egypt, heard their cries, and have come to rescue them. Now, come—I am sending you to Egypt.

verses.kjv: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.
verses.decoded: This Moses, whom they rejected, asking, 'Who made you a leader and judge?'—God sent him as a leader and deliverer through the angel who appeared in the bush.

verses.kjv: He brought them out, after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.
verses.decoded: He led them out after performing miracles and signs in Egypt, at the Red Sea, and during forty years in the wilderness.

verses.kjv: This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear.
verses.decoded: This is the Moses who told the Israelites, 'The Lord your God will raise up a prophet like me from among your own people. You must listen to him.'

verses.kjv: This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us:
verses.decoded: He was with the assembly in the wilderness, with the angel who spoke to him on Mount Sinai and with our ancestors. He received God’s living messages to give to us.

verses.kjv: To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,
verses.decoded: But our ancestors refused to obey him and rejected him. In their hearts, they turned back to Egypt.

verses.kjv: Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
verses.decoded: They said to Aaron, 'Make us gods to lead us, because we don’t know what happened to this Moses who brought us out of Egypt.'

verses.kjv: And they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice unto the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.
verses.decoded: So they made a calf idol, offered sacrifices to it, and celebrated what their own hands had made.

verses.kjv: Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O ye house of Israel, have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in the wilderness?
verses.decoded: Then God allowed them to worship the stars and sky, as the prophet wrote: 'House of Israel, did you offer me sacrifices and burnt offerings for forty years in the wilderness?'

verses.kjv: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.
verses.decoded: You worshiped the tent of Moloch and the star of your god Remphan—idols you made to worship. I will exile you beyond Babylon.

verses.kjv: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness, as he had appointed, speaking unto Moses, that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen.
verses.decoded: Our ancestors had the tabernacle in the wilderness, just as God commanded Moses, who was told to build it following the pattern he was shown.

verses.kjv: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles, whom God drave out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David;
verses.decoded: Later generations of our ancestors brought this tabernacle with Joshua when they took possession of the lands of the Gentiles, whom God had driven out before them until the time of David.

verses.kjv: Who found favour before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.
verses.decoded: He was accepted by God and wanted to build a dwelling place for the God of Jacob.

verses.kjv: But Solomon built him an house.
verses.decoded: But Solomon built a temple for Him.

verses.kjv: Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands; as saith the prophet,
verses.decoded: However, the Most High does not live in temples made by human hands, as the prophet says,

verses.kjv: Heaven is my throne, and earth is my footstool: what house will ye build me? saith the Lord: or what is the place of my rest?
verses.decoded: "Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build for me?" says the Lord. "Where will my resting place be?"

verses.kjv: Hath not my hand made all these things?
verses.decoded: Didn’t I create all these things with my own hands?

verses.kjv: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do ye.
verses.decoded: You are stubborn and refuse to listen or obey. You always resist the Holy Spirit, just like your ancestors did.

verses.kjv: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers:
verses.decoded: Which prophet did your ancestors not persecute? They even killed those who predicted the coming of the Righteous One, and now you have betrayed and murdered Him.

verses.kjv: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept it.
verses.decoded: You received the law given through angels, but you have not obeyed it.

verses.kjv: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.
verses.decoded: When they heard this, they were deeply angered and ground their teeth at him.

verses.kjv: But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
verses.decoded: But Stephen, full of the Holy Spirit, looked up to heaven and saw God’s glory and Jesus standing at God’s right side.

verses.kjv: And said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.
verses.decoded: He said, "Look, I see the heavens open and the Son of Man standing at God’s right hand."

verses.kjv: Then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and ran upon him with one accord,
verses.decoded: Then they shouted loudly, covered their ears, and all rushed at him together,

verses.kjv: And cast him out of the city, and stoned him: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man’s feet, whose name was Saul.
verses.decoded: They dragged him out of the city and began to stone him. The people who were stoning him put their clothes at the feet of a young man named Saul.

verses.kjv: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.
verses.decoded: While they were stoning Stephen, he prayed, "Lord Jesus, receive my spirit."

verses.kjv: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
verses.decoded: Then he knelt down and shouted, "Lord, don’t hold this sin against them." After saying this, he died peacefully.

verses.kjv: And Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judaea and Samaria, except the apostles.
verses.decoded: Saul agreed to the killing. At that time, there was a severe persecution against the church in Jerusalem, and all the believers were scattered throughout Judea and Samaria, except for the apostles.

verses.kjv: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial, and made great lamentation over him.
verses.decoded: Godly men took Stephen's body and buried him, mourning deeply for him.

verses.kjv: As for Saul, he made havock of the church, entering into every house, and haling men and women committed them to prison.
verses.decoded: Saul was destroying the church by going into people's homes, dragging off both men and women, and putting them in prison.

verses.kjv: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.
verses.decoded: So those who were scattered preached the message everywhere they went.

verses.kjv: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and preached Christ unto them.
verses.decoded: Philip traveled to the city of Samaria and preached about Christ to the people there.

verses.kjv: And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spake, hearing and seeing the miracles which he did.
verses.decoded: The people all listened closely to Philip’s message, seeing and hearing the miracles he performed.

verses.kjv: For unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed with them: and many taken with palsies, and that were lame, were healed.
verses.decoded: Many who were possessed by evil spirits screamed loudly as they left, and many who were paralyzed or lame were healed.

verses.kjv: And there was great joy in that city.
verses.decoded: The city was filled with great joy.

verses.kjv: But there was a certain man, called Simon, which beforetime in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of Samaria, giving out that himself was some great one:
verses.decoded: But there was a man named Simon who had previously practiced magic in that city and amazed the people of Samaria, claiming to be someone very important.

verses.kjv: To whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God.
verses.decoded: Everyone, from the least to the greatest, paid attention to him and said, 'This man is the great power of God.'

verses.kjv: And to him they had regard, because that of long time he had bewitched them with sorceries.
verses.decoded: They respected him because he had amazed them for a long time with his magic.

verses.kjv: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God, and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
verses.decoded: But when they believed Philip’s message about God’s kingdom and Jesus Christ, both men and women were baptized.

verses.kjv: Then Simon himself believed also: and when he was baptized, he continued with Philip, and wondered, beholding the miracles and signs which were done.
verses.decoded: Simon himself believed and was baptized. He stayed with Philip and was amazed as he saw the miracles and signs being performed.

verses.kjv: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent unto them Peter and John:
verses.decoded: When the apostles in Jerusalem heard that Samaria had accepted God’s message, they sent Peter and John to them.

verses.kjv: Who, when they were come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Ghost:
verses.decoded: When Peter and John arrived, they prayed for the new believers so they could receive the Holy Spirit.

verses.kjv: (For as yet he was fallen upon none of them: only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.)
verses.decoded: The Holy Spirit had not yet come upon any of them; they had only been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

verses.kjv: Then laid they their hands on them, and they received the Holy Ghost.
verses.decoded: Then the apostles laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

verses.kjv: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles’ hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money,
verses.decoded: When Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given when the apostles laid hands on people, he offered them money,

verses.kjv: Saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Ghost.
verses.decoded: Saying, 'Give me this power too, so that when I lay my hands on someone, they will receive the Holy Spirit.'

verses.kjv: But Peter said unto him, Thy money perish with thee, because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money.
verses.decoded: But Peter replied, 'May your money be destroyed with you, because you thought you could buy God's gift with money!'

verses.kjv: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter: for thy heart is not right in the sight of God.
verses.decoded: You have no share or part in this, because your heart is not right before God.

verses.kjv: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray God, if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee.
verses.decoded: Repent of this evil thought of yours and pray to the Lord. Maybe he will forgive the intention of your heart.

verses.kjv: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness, and in the bond of iniquity.
verses.decoded: I see that you are full of bitterness and captive to sin.

verses.kjv: Then answered Simon, and said, Pray ye to the LORD for me, that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me.
verses.decoded: Simon answered, 'Pray to the Lord for me so that none of what you said will happen to me.'

verses.kjv: And they, when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans.
verses.decoded: After they had testified and preached the Lord’s message, they returned to Jerusalem and preached the gospel in many Samaritan villages.

verses.kjv: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza, which is desert.
verses.decoded: An angel of the Lord told Philip, 'Get up and go south on the road from Jerusalem to Gaza; it’s a desert area.'

verses.kjv: And he arose and went: and, behold, a man of Ethiopia, an eunuch of great authority under Candace queen of the Ethiopians, who had the charge of all her treasure, and had come to Jerusalem for to worship,
verses.decoded: Philip got up and went. There he saw an Ethiopian man, a eunuch who was a high official in charge of all the queen’s treasure, who had come to Jerusalem to worship.

verses.kjv: Was returning, and sitting in his chariot read Esaias the prophet.
verses.decoded: As he was returning home, he was sitting in his chariot reading the prophet Isaiah.

verses.kjv: Then the Spirit said unto Philip, Go near, and join thyself to this chariot.
verses.decoded: The Holy Spirit told Philip, 'Go over and stay near that chariot.'

verses.kjv: And Philip ran thither to him, and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?
verses.decoded: Philip ran to the chariot, heard the man reading Isaiah, and asked, 'Do you understand what you are reading?'

verses.kjv: And he said, How can I, except some man should guide me? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him.
verses.decoded: He said, 'How can I understand unless someone explains it to me?' So he asked Philip to come and sit with him.

verses.kjv: The place of the scripture which he read was this, He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; and like a lamb dumb before his shearer, so opened he not his mouth:
verses.decoded: The passage he was reading said, 'He was led like a sheep to be slaughtered; he did not open his mouth, like a lamb silent before its shearer.'

verses.kjv: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away: and who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken from the earth.
verses.decoded: He was humiliated and had no justice; who can describe his descendants? Because his life was taken away from the earth.

verses.kjv: And the eunuch answered Philip, and said, I pray thee, of whom speaketh the prophet this? of himself, or of some other man?
verses.decoded: The eunuch asked Philip, 'Please tell me, is the prophet talking about himself or someone else?'

verses.kjv: Then Philip opened his mouth, and began at the same scripture, and preached unto him Jesus.
verses.decoded: Philip started explaining the scripture and told him the good news about Jesus.

verses.kjv: And as they went on their way, they came unto a certain water: and the eunuch said, See, here is water; what doth hinder me to be baptized?
verses.decoded: As they traveled, they came to some water. The eunuch said, 'Look, here is water. What stops me from being baptized?'

verses.kjv: And Philip said, If thou believest with all thine heart, thou mayest. And he answered and said, I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.
verses.decoded: Philip said, 'If you truly believe with all your heart, you may.' The eunuch replied, 'I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.'

verses.kjv: And he commanded the chariot to stand still: and they went down both into the water, both Philip and the eunuch; and he baptized him.
verses.decoded: The eunuch told the chariot to stop. Then both Philip and the eunuch went down into the water, and Philip baptized him.

verses.kjv: And when they were come up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip, that the eunuch saw him no more: and he went on his way rejoicing.
verses.decoded: After coming out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord suddenly took Philip away, and the eunuch never saw him again. The eunuch went on his way happy.

verses.kjv: But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached in all the cities, till he came to Caesarea.
verses.decoded: Philip was later found in Azotus. As he traveled, he preached in all the towns until he reached Caesarea.

verses.kjv: And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest,
verses.decoded: Saul was still full of threats and eager to kill the Lord's followers, so he went to the high priest,

verses.kjv: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues, that if he found any of this way, whether they were men or women, he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: He asked the high priest for letters to the synagogues in Damascus so that if he found any followers of this way, men or women, he could arrest them and bring them to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven:
verses.decoded: As he was traveling near Damascus, a bright light from heaven suddenly surrounded him.

verses.kjv: And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
verses.decoded: He fell to the ground and heard a voice say, 'Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?'

verses.kjv: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.
verses.decoded: Saul asked, 'Who are you, Lord?' The Lord replied, 'I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting. It is painful and useless for you to resist.'

verses.kjv: And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what wilt thou have me to do? And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.
verses.decoded: Shaken and amazed, Saul asked, 'Lord, what do you want me to do?' The Lord told him, 'Get up and go into the city; you will be told what to do.'

verses.kjv: And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man.
verses.decoded: The men traveling with Saul were silent, hearing the voice but seeing no one.

verses.kjv: And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw no man: but they led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.
verses.decoded: Saul got up from the ground, but when he opened his eyes, he couldn't see anything. So they took him by the hand and led him into Damascus.

verses.kjv: And he was three days without sight, and neither did eat nor drink.
