verses.decoded: For three days, Saul was blind and did not eat or drink anything.

verses.kjv: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here, Lord.
verses.decoded: There was a disciple in Damascus named Ananias. The Lord spoke to him in a vision, saying, 'Ananias.' He replied, 'Here I am, Lord.'

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,
verses.decoded: The Lord told Ananias, 'Get up and go to Straight Street. Find the house of Judas and ask for Saul of Tarsus, because he is praying there.'

verses.kjv: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting his hand on him, that he might receive his sight.
verses.decoded: Saul has seen a vision of a man named Ananias coming to him and placing his hands on him so he can see again.

verses.kjv: Then Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard by many of this man, how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem:
verses.decoded: Ananias replied, 'Lord, I have heard from many people how much harm this man has done to your followers in Jerusalem.'

verses.kjv: And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name.
verses.decoded: He even has official permission from the chief priests to arrest everyone who calls on your name.

verses.kjv: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:
verses.decoded: But the Lord told him, 'Go, because Saul is my chosen instrument to carry my name to the Gentiles, kings, and the people of Israel.'

verses.kjv: For I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my name’s sake.
verses.decoded: I will show him how much he must suffer for my name.

verses.kjv: And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.
verses.decoded: Ananias went to the house, laid his hands on Saul, and said, 'Brother Saul, the Lord Jesus who appeared to you on the road has sent me so you can see again and be filled with the Holy Spirit.'

verses.kjv: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized.
verses.decoded: Immediately, something like scales fell from Saul’s eyes, he could see again, got up, and was baptized.

verses.kjv: And when he had received meat, he was strengthened. Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus.
verses.decoded: After eating, Saul regained his strength and stayed several days with the disciples in Damascus.

verses.kjv: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.
verses.decoded: Right away, Saul preached in the synagogues that Jesus is the Son of God.

verses.kjv: But all that heard him were amazed, and said; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem, and came hither for that intent, that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests?
verses.decoded: Everyone who heard him was amazed and said, 'Isn’t this the man who persecuted those who called on Jesus in Jerusalem and came here to arrest them?'

verses.kjv: But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is very Christ.
verses.decoded: But Saul grew stronger and confused the Jews in Damascus by proving that Jesus is truly the Messiah.

verses.kjv: And after that many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel to kill him:
verses.decoded: After some time, the Jews planned to kill Saul.

verses.kjv: But their laying await was known of Saul. And they watched the gates day and night to kill him.
verses.decoded: Saul learned about their plan, and they guarded the city gates day and night to kill him.

verses.kjv: Then the disciples took him by night, and let him down by the wall in a basket.
verses.decoded: So the disciples lowered Saul at night in a basket through an opening in the city wall.

verses.kjv: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.
verses.decoded: When Saul arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to join the disciples, but they were all afraid of him and didn’t believe he was really a follower.

verses.kjv: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.
verses.decoded: But Barnabas took Saul to the apostles and explained how Saul had seen the Lord on the road, spoken with Him, and boldly preached in Damascus in Jesus’ name.

verses.kjv: And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Saul stayed with the believers in Jerusalem, going in and out among them freely.

verses.kjv: And he spake boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus, and disputed against the Grecians: but they went about to slay him.
verses.decoded: He spoke boldly in Jesus’ name and debated with the Greek-speaking Jews, but they tried to kill him.

verses.kjv: Which when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.
verses.decoded: When the believers learned of this, they took Saul to Caesarea and sent him to his hometown of Tarsus for safety.

verses.kjv: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.
verses.decoded: The churches throughout Judea, Galilee, and Samaria experienced peace and were strengthened. As they lived reverently before the Lord and were encouraged by the Holy Spirit, their numbers grew.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters, he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.
verses.decoded: As Peter traveled through the region, he also went to visit the believers living in Lydda.

verses.kjv: And there he found a certain man named Aeneas, which had kept his bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy.
verses.decoded: There he found a man named Aeneas who had been bedridden for eight years because he was paralyzed.

verses.kjv: And Peter said unto him, Aeneas, Jesus Christ maketh thee whole: arise, and make thy bed. And he arose immediately.
verses.decoded: Peter said to him, 'Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed.' He got up right away.

verses.kjv: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord.
verses.decoded: Everyone living in Lydda and the nearby area of Sharon saw this and turned to the Lord.

verses.kjv: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.
verses.decoded: In Joppa there was a disciple named Tabitha, also called Dorcas. She was known for her good works and acts of charity.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that she was sick, and died: whom when they had washed, they laid her in an upper chamber.
verses.decoded: At that time, she became sick and died. After they washed her body, they placed her in an upstairs room.

verses.kjv: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent unto him two men, desiring him that he would not delay to come to them.
verses.decoded: Since Lydda was near Joppa and the believers heard Peter was there, they sent two men to ask him to come quickly.

verses.kjv: Then Peter arose and went with them. When he was come, they brought him into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by him weeping, and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made, while she was with them.
verses.decoded: Peter got up and went with them. When he arrived, they took him to the upstairs room where widows stood around him crying and showing the clothes Dorcas had made while she was alive.

verses.kjv: But Peter put them all forth, and kneeled down, and prayed; and turning him to the body said, Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes: and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
verses.decoded: Peter sent everyone out, knelt down, and prayed. Then he turned to her body and said, 'Tabitha, get up.' She opened her eyes, saw Peter, and sat up.

verses.kjv: And he gave her his hand, and lifted her up, and when he had called the saints and widows, presented her alive.
verses.decoded: He helped her up by the hand, then called the believers and widows and showed them that she was alive.

verses.kjv: And it was known throughout all Joppa; and many believed in the Lord.
verses.decoded: News of this spread throughout Joppa, and many people believed in the Lord.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.
verses.decoded: Peter stayed in Joppa for several days with a man named Simon, who worked as a leatherworker.

verses.kjv: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band,
verses.decoded: There was a man named Cornelius living in Caesarea. He was a centurion in the Italian regiment.

verses.kjv: A devout man, and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway.
verses.decoded: He was a religious man who respected God deeply, along with his entire family. He gave generously to those in need and prayed regularly.

verses.kjv: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him, and saying unto him, Cornelius.
verses.decoded: Around three in the afternoon, he clearly saw a vision where an angel of God appeared and called his name, Cornelius.

verses.kjv: And when he looked on him, he was afraid, and said, What is it, Lord? And he said unto him, Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God.
verses.decoded: When Cornelius saw the angel, he was scared and asked, 'What do you want, Lord?' The angel replied, 'God has noticed your prayers and your generous gifts.'

verses.kjv: And now send men to Joppa, and call for one Simon, whose surname is Peter:
verses.decoded: Now send some men to Joppa to bring back a man named Simon, also called Peter.

verses.kjv: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side: he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do.
verses.decoded: Peter is staying with a man named Simon, who works with animal skins, and his house is near the sea. Peter will tell you what you need to do.

verses.kjv: And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed, he called two of his household servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;
verses.decoded: After the angel left, Cornelius called two of his servants and a religious soldier who regularly served him.

verses.kjv: And when he had declared all these things unto them, he sent them to Joppa.
verses.decoded: He told them everything the angel had said and sent them off to Joppa.

verses.kjv: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:
verses.decoded: The next day, as the men traveled and neared the city, Peter went to the roof of the house to pray around noon.

verses.kjv: And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,
verses.decoded: Peter became very hungry and was about to eat, but while the food was being prepared, he fell into a trance.

verses.kjv: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending unto him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:
verses.decoded: He saw heaven open and something like a large sheet being lowered to the ground, tied at the four corners.

verses.kjv: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
verses.decoded: Inside the sheet were all kinds of animals: land animals with four legs, wild animals, reptiles, and birds.

verses.kjv: And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill, and eat.
verses.decoded: A voice said to Peter, 'Get up, kill these animals, and eat them.'

verses.kjv: But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean.
verses.decoded: Peter replied, 'No, Lord, I have never eaten anything unclean or forbidden.'

verses.kjv: And the voice spake unto him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
verses.decoded: The voice spoke again, 'Don’t call anything unclean if God has made it clean.'

verses.kjv: This was done thrice: and the vessel was received up again into heaven.
verses.decoded: This happened three times, and then the container was taken back up into heaven.

verses.kjv: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon’s house, and stood before the gate,
verses.decoded: While Peter was still wondering what the vision meant, the men sent by Cornelius arrived and asked for Simon's house, standing at the gate.

verses.kjv: And called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter, were lodged there.
verses.decoded: They called out and asked if Simon, also called Peter, was staying there.

verses.kjv: While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek thee.
verses.decoded: As Peter was thinking about the vision, the Holy Spirit told him, 'Look, three men are looking for you.'

verses.kjv: Arise therefore, and get thee down, and go with them, doubting nothing: for I have sent them.
verses.decoded: Get up, go downstairs, and go with them without hesitation, because I have sent them.

verses.kjv: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom ye seek: what is the cause wherefore ye are come?
verses.decoded: So Peter went down to the men sent by Cornelius and said, 'I am the one you are looking for. Why have you come?'

verses.kjv: And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that feareth God, and of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house, and to hear words of thee.
verses.decoded: They replied, 'Cornelius, a Roman officer who is a good and God-fearing man respected by all the Jews, was told by an angel from God to send for you to come to his house and listen to what you have to say.'

verses.kjv: Then called he them in, and lodged them. And on the morrow Peter went away with them, and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him.
verses.decoded: Peter invited them in and let them stay. The next day, Peter left with them, accompanied by some believers from Joppa.

verses.kjv: And the morrow after they entered into Caesarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.
verses.decoded: The day after that, they arrived in Caesarea. Cornelius was waiting for them and had gathered his relatives and close friends.

verses.kjv: And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him.
verses.decoded: When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell at his feet, and worshiped him.

verses.kjv: But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.
verses.decoded: Peter helped him up and said, 'Stand up! I am just a man like you.'

verses.kjv: And as he talked with him, he went in, and found many that were come together.
verses.decoded: While talking with Cornelius, Peter went inside and saw many people gathered there.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean.
verses.decoded: Peter told them, 'You know that it is against our Jewish law for a Jew to associate with or visit someone from another nation, but God has shown me that I should not consider anyone unclean or unworthy.'

verses.kjv: Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying, as soon as I was sent for: I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me?
verses.decoded: So I came without hesitation as soon as I was sent for. Now I want to know why you sent for me.

verses.kjv: And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and, behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,
verses.decoded: Cornelius replied, 'Four days ago I was fasting until this time, and at the ninth hour I was praying at home when suddenly a man in shining clothes appeared before me.'

verses.kjv: And said, Cornelius, thy prayer is heard, and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God.
verses.decoded: He said, 'Cornelius, God has heard your prayer and remembers the gifts you have given.'

verses.kjv: Send therefore to Joppa, and call hither Simon, whose surname is Peter; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side: who, when he cometh, shall speak unto thee.
verses.decoded: So send for Simon, also called Peter, who is staying at the house of Simon the tanner by the sea in Joppa. When he arrives, he will speak to you.

verses.kjv: Immediately therefore I sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou art come. Now therefore are we all here present before God, to hear all things that are commanded thee of God.
verses.decoded: So I sent for you right away, and it was good that you came. Now we are all here before God to listen to everything God has commanded you to tell us.

verses.kjv: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:
verses.decoded: Then Peter began to speak: 'I now realize that God does not show favoritism to anyone.'

verses.kjv: But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him.
verses.decoded: Instead, in every nation, anyone who fears God and does what is right is accepted by Him.

verses.kjv: The word which God sent unto the children of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ: (he is Lord of all:)
verses.decoded: God sent this message to the people of Israel, announcing peace through Jesus Christ, who is Lord of everyone.

verses.kjv: That word, I say, ye know, which was published throughout all Judaea, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;
verses.decoded: You know this message—it spread throughout Judea, starting in Galilee after John’s baptism.

verses.kjv: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.
verses.decoded: God empowered Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and power. He went around doing good and healing everyone under the devil’s control, because God was with him.

verses.kjv: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree:
verses.decoded: We are witnesses to everything Jesus did in Judea and Jerusalem, including how they killed him by hanging him on a tree.

verses.kjv: Him God raised up the third day, and shewed him openly;
verses.decoded: But God raised him up on the third day and showed him to many people.

verses.kjv: Not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before of God, even to us, who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead.
verses.decoded: Not everyone saw him, but God chose certain witnesses—us—who ate and drank with him after he rose.

verses.kjv: And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead.
verses.decoded: Jesus commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that he is the one God appointed to judge the living and the dead.

verses.kjv: To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins.
verses.decoded: All the prophets testify about him, saying that everyone who believes in his name will have their sins forgiven.

verses.kjv: While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.
verses.decoded: While Peter was still speaking, the Holy Spirit came upon everyone who was listening to his message.

verses.kjv: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost.
verses.decoded: The Jewish believers who came with Peter were amazed because the gift of the Holy Spirit was also given to the Gentiles.

verses.kjv: For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify God. Then answered Peter,
verses.decoded: They heard them speaking in different languages and praising God. Then Peter responded,

verses.kjv: Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we?
verses.decoded: Who can stop us from baptizing these people with water, since they have received the Holy Spirit just like we have?

verses.kjv: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.
verses.decoded: So he ordered them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. After that, they asked him to stay with them for a few days.

verses.kjv: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judaea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
verses.decoded: The apostles and believers in Judea heard that non-Jewish people had also accepted God's message.

verses.kjv: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,
verses.decoded: When Peter returned to Jerusalem, some Jewish believers criticized him strongly.

verses.kjv: Saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.
verses.decoded: They said, 'You went into the homes of uncircumcised people and ate with them.'

verses.kjv: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order unto them, saying,
verses.decoded: But Peter explained everything to them in detail from the start, saying,

verses.kjv: I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:
verses.decoded: I was praying in Joppa when I had a vision: something like a large sheet was lowered from heaven, coming right to me.

verses.kjv: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
verses.decoded: When I looked closely, I saw all kinds of animals—land animals, wild animals, reptiles, and birds.

verses.kjv: And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.
verses.decoded: I heard a voice telling me, 'Get up, Peter, kill and eat.'

verses.kjv: But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth.
verses.decoded: But I replied, 'No, Lord, I have never eaten anything unclean.'

verses.kjv: But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
verses.decoded: But the voice answered, 'Don’t call anything impure if God has made it clean.'

verses.kjv: And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.
verses.decoded: This happened three times, and then the sheet was taken back up to heaven.

verses.kjv: And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Caesarea unto me.
verses.decoded: Right then, three men arrived at the house where I was staying; they had been sent from Caesarea to find me.

verses.kjv: And the Spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house:
verses.decoded: The Holy Spirit told me to go with them without hesitation. Six other believers went with me, and we entered the man’s house.

verses.kjv: And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house, which stood and said unto him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter;
verses.decoded: He explained how he had seen an angel in his home who told him to send for Simon, also called Peter, from Joppa.

verses.kjv: Who shall tell thee words, whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved.
verses.decoded: Peter would tell him words that would bring salvation to him and his entire family.

verses.kjv: And as I began to speak, the Holy Ghost fell on them, as on us at the beginning.
verses.decoded: As I started speaking, the Holy Spirit came upon them just like it did to us at the start.

verses.kjv: Then remembered I the word of the Lord, how that he said, John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost.
verses.decoded: Then I remembered what the Lord said: John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.

verses.kjv: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?
verses.decoded: Since God gave them the same gift as He gave us who believed in the Lord Jesus, who was I to oppose God?

verses.kjv: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.
verses.decoded: When they heard this, they became silent and praised God, saying, 'God has also given the Gentiles the chance to turn to life.'

verses.kjv: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.
verses.decoded: Those who were scattered because of the persecution against Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching only to Jews.

verses.kjv: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Grecians, preaching the LORD Jesus.
verses.decoded: Some men from Cyprus and Cyrene went to Antioch and began speaking to Greek-speaking people, preaching about the Lord Jesus.

verses.kjv: And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto the Lord.
verses.decoded: The Lord was with them, and many people believed and turned to the Lord.

verses.kjv: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.
verses.decoded: News of this reached the church in Jerusalem, so they sent Barnabas to Antioch.

verses.kjv: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.
verses.decoded: When Barnabas arrived and saw God's grace, he was glad and encouraged everyone to remain faithful to the Lord with all their hearts.

verses.kjv: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.
verses.decoded: Barnabas was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and faith, and many people were added to the Lord.

verses.kjv: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:
verses.decoded: Then Barnabas went to Tarsus to find Saul.

verses.kjv: And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.
verses.decoded: When Barnabas found Saul, he brought him to Antioch. They stayed there for a whole year, meeting with the church and teaching many people. It was in Antioch that the followers of Jesus were first called Christians.

verses.kjv: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch.
verses.decoded: During this time, some prophets came from Jerusalem to Antioch.

verses.kjv: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the Spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar.
verses.decoded: One of them, named Agabus, stood up and, through the Spirit, predicted a severe famine that would affect the whole world. This happened during the reign of Emperor Claudius.

verses.kjv: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judaea:
verses.decoded: The disciples decided, each according to their ability, to send help to the believers living in Judea.

verses.kjv: Which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
verses.decoded: They did this and sent the aid to the elders in Judea through Barnabas and Saul.

verses.kjv: Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church.
verses.decoded: At that time, King Herod began to persecute some members of the church.

verses.kjv: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.
verses.decoded: He killed James, the brother of John, by the sword.

verses.kjv: And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.)
verses.decoded: Since he saw that this pleased the Jewish people, he went on to arrest Peter as well. (This happened during the Feast of Unleavened Bread.)

verses.kjv: And when he had apprehended him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people.
verses.decoded: After arresting him, Herod put Peter in prison and assigned sixteen soldiers (four groups of four) to guard him, planning to bring him out to the people after Passover.

verses.kjv: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.
verses.decoded: Peter was kept in prison, but the church prayed earnestly and continuously to God for him.

verses.kjv: And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.
verses.decoded: On the night Herod planned to bring him out, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, chained with two chains, while guards stood at the prison door.

verses.kjv: And, behold, the angel of the Lord came upon him, and a light shined in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his chains fell off from his hands.
verses.decoded: Suddenly, an angel of the Lord appeared, and a light shone in the prison. The angel touched Peter, woke him up, and said, 'Get up quickly!' At once, Peter’s chains fell off his hands.

verses.kjv: And the angel said unto him, Gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals. And so he did. And he saith unto him, Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.
verses.decoded: The angel told him, 'Put on your belt and sandals.' Peter did so. Then the angel said, 'Wrap your cloak around you and follow me.'

verses.kjv: And he went out, and followed him; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel; but thought he saw a vision.
verses.decoded: Peter followed the angel, but he didn’t realize it was real; he thought he was seeing a vision.

verses.kjv: When they were past the first and the second ward, they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city; which opened to them of his own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and forthwith the angel departed from him.
verses.decoded: They passed the first and second prison guards and reached the iron gate leading to the city. The gate opened by itself, and they walked through one street. Then the angel left him.

verses.kjv: And when Peter was come to himself, he said, Now I know of a surety, that the LORD hath sent his angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews.
verses.decoded: When Peter fully realized what had happened, he said, 'Now I am sure that the Lord sent his angel and rescued me from Herod’s power and from what the Jewish people expected.'

verses.kjv: And when he had considered the thing, he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying.
verses.decoded: After thinking about it, Peter went to the house of Mary, the mother of John Mark, where many people were gathered and praying.

verses.kjv: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a damsel came to hearken, named Rhoda.
verses.decoded: Peter knocked at the gate, and a servant girl named Rhoda came to listen and see who was there.

verses.kjv: And when she knew Peter’s voice, she opened not the gate for gladness, but ran in, and told how Peter stood before the gate.
verses.decoded: When Rhoda recognized Peter’s voice, she was so excited she didn’t open the gate but ran inside to tell everyone Peter was at the door.

verses.kjv: And they said unto her, Thou art mad. But she constantly affirmed that it was even so. Then said they, It is his angel.
verses.decoded: They told her she was crazy, but she insisted it was true. Then they said, 'It must be his angel.'

verses.kjv: But Peter continued knocking: and when they had opened the door, and saw him, they were astonished.
verses.decoded: But Peter kept knocking, and when they opened the door and saw him, they were amazed.

verses.kjv: But he, beckoning unto them with the hand to hold their peace, declared unto them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he said, Go shew these things unto James, and to the brethren. And he departed, and went into another place.
verses.decoded: Peter motioned for them to be quiet and told them how the Lord had rescued him from prison. Then he said, 'Tell James and the other believers what happened.' After that, he left and went somewhere else.

verses.kjv: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of Peter.
verses.decoded: At daybreak, there was a great commotion among the soldiers wondering what had happened to Peter.

verses.kjv: And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the keepers, and commanded that they should be put to death. And he went down from Judaea to Caesarea, and there abode.
verses.decoded: Herod searched for Peter but couldn’t find him. He questioned the guards and ordered them to be executed. Then he left Judea and went to live in Caesarea.

verses.kjv: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king’s chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king’s country.
verses.decoded: Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon, but they all came together and made Blastus, the king’s chamberlain, their friend. They asked for peace because their region depended on the king’s territory for food.

verses.kjv: And upon a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration unto them.
verses.decoded: On a certain day, Herod dressed in royal clothes, sat on his throne, and gave a speech to the people.

verses.kjv: And the people gave a shout, saying, It is the voice of a god, and not of a man.
verses.decoded: The crowd shouted, 'This is the voice of a god, not a man!'

verses.kjv: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.
verses.decoded: Right away, an angel of the Lord struck him down because he did not give glory to God. He was eaten by worms and died.

verses.kjv: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
verses.decoded: Meanwhile, God’s message continued to spread and increase.

verses.kjv: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their ministry, and took with them John, whose surname was Mark.
verses.decoded: Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem after completing their mission, bringing along John, also called Mark.

verses.kjv: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
verses.decoded: In the church at Antioch, there were some prophets and teachers, including Barnabas, Simeon called Niger, Lucius from Cyrene, Manaen who had been raised with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

verses.kjv: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.
verses.decoded: While they were worshiping the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit told them, 'Set apart Barnabas and Saul for the special work I have called them to do.'

verses.kjv: And when they had fasted and prayed, and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.
verses.decoded: After fasting, praying, and laying hands on them, they sent Barnabas and Saul off on their mission.

verses.kjv: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.
verses.decoded: Guided by the Holy Spirit, they left for Seleucia and then sailed to the island of Cyprus.

verses.kjv: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister.
verses.decoded: When they reached Salamis, they preached God's message in the Jewish synagogues, and John was with them as their helper.

verses.kjv: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Barjesus:
verses.decoded: After traveling across the island to Paphos, they met a Jewish sorcerer and false prophet named Barjesus.

verses.kjv: Which was with the deputy of the country, Sergius Paulus, a prudent man; who called for Barnabas and Saul, and desired to hear the word of God.
verses.decoded: Barjesus was with Sergius Paulus, the local governor, who was wise and wanted to hear the message from Barnabas and Saul.

verses.kjv: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.
verses.decoded: But Elymas, the sorcerer (which means 'wise man'), opposed them and tried to stop the governor from believing.

verses.kjv: Then Saul, (who also is called Paul,) filled with the Holy Ghost, set his eyes on him,
verses.decoded: Then Saul, also known as Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, looked directly at Elymas.

verses.kjv: And said, O full of all subtilty and all mischief, thou child of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?
verses.decoded: Paul said, 'You are full of trickery and evil, a child of the devil and enemy of everything right. Will you not stop twisting God's ways?'

verses.kjv: And now, behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand.
verses.decoded: Paul said, 'Now the power of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind for a time, unable to see the sun.' Immediately, darkness covered Elymas, and he had to be led around by others.

verses.kjv: Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.
verses.decoded: When the governor saw what happened, he believed, amazed by the teaching about the Lord.

verses.kjv: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: After leaving Paphos, Paul and his group traveled to Perga in Pamphylia. John left them there and went back to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.
verses.decoded: After leaving Perga, they went to Antioch in Pisidia, and on the Sabbath day, they went into the synagogue and sat down to teach.

verses.kjv: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, Ye men and brethren, if ye have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.
verses.decoded: After the law and the prophets were read, the synagogue leaders invited them, saying, 'Brothers, if you have any encouraging message for the people, please speak.'

verses.kjv: Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, Men of Israel, and ye that fear God, give audience.
verses.decoded: Then Paul stood up, motioned with his hand, and said, 'Men of Israel and all who respect God, listen to me.'

verses.kjv: The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm brought he them out of it.
verses.decoded: The God of Israel chose our ancestors and honored the people while they lived as foreigners in Egypt. He powerfully brought them out of that land.

verses.kjv: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness.
verses.decoded: For about forty years, he patiently cared for them in the wilderness, guiding and providing for them like a nurse cares for a child.

verses.kjv: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Chanaan, he divided their land to them by lot.
verses.decoded: After destroying seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave their land to the Israelites by casting lots.

verses.kjv: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.
verses.decoded: After that, he provided judges to lead them for about 450 years, until the time of the prophet Samuel.

verses.kjv: And afterward they desired a king: and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.
verses.decoded: Later, the people asked for a king, and God gave them Saul, son of Kis, from the tribe of Benjamin, who ruled for about forty years.

verses.kjv: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.
verses.decoded: When God removed Saul, he made David their king. God testified about David, saying, 'I have found David, son of Jesse, a man after my own heart who will do everything I want.'

verses.kjv: Of this man’s seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus:
verses.decoded: From David’s descendants, God has fulfilled his promise by raising up Jesus as a Savior for Israel.

verses.kjv: When John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.
verses.decoded: Before Jesus came, John preached to all the people of Israel, baptizing them as a sign of repentance.

verses.kjv: And as John fulfilled his course, he said, Whom think ye that I am? I am not he. But, behold, there cometh one after me, whose shoes of his feet I am not worthy to loose.
verses.decoded: When John finished his work, he asked, 'Who do you think I am? I am not the Messiah. Look, someone is coming after me whose sandals I am not worthy to untie.'

verses.kjv: Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you feareth God, to you is the word of this salvation sent.
verses.decoded: Brothers and fellow Israelites, descendants of Abraham, and all who respect God, this message of salvation is sent to you.

verses.kjv: For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day, they have fulfilled them in condemning him.
verses.decoded: But those living in Jerusalem and their leaders did not recognize Jesus or the prophecies read every Sabbath. By condemning him, they fulfilled those prophecies.

verses.kjv: And though they found no cause of death in him, yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain.
verses.decoded: Even though they found no reason to put him to death, they asked Pilate to have him killed.

verses.kjv: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a sepulchre.
verses.decoded: After fulfilling everything written about him, they took Jesus down from the cross and placed him in a tomb.

verses.kjv: But God raised him from the dead:
verses.decoded: But God raised him from the dead.

verses.kjv: And he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses unto the people.
verses.decoded: Jesus was seen alive for many days by those who had traveled with him from Galilee to Jerusalem; these people are witnesses to the public.

verses.kjv: And we declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which was made unto the fathers,
verses.decoded: We bring you good news about the promise God made to our ancestors,

verses.kjv: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he hath raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.
verses.decoded: God has fulfilled that promise to us, their descendants, by raising Jesus from the dead. This is also written in the second Psalm: 'You are my Son; today I have become your Father.'

verses.kjv: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, I will give you the sure mercies of David.
verses.decoded: Regarding raising Jesus from the dead, never to decay again, God said, 'I will give you the promised blessings of David.'

verses.kjv: Wherefore he saith also in another psalm, Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
verses.decoded: That’s why another Psalm says, 'You will not let your Holy One see decay.'

verses.kjv: For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption:
verses.decoded: David died after serving his generation according to God’s plan and was buried with his ancestors, and his body decayed.

verses.kjv: But he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.
verses.decoded: But Jesus, whom God raised from the dead, did not experience decay.

verses.kjv: Be it known unto you therefore, men and brethren, that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins:
verses.decoded: So, brothers and sisters, know this: through Jesus, forgiveness of sins is being offered to you.

verses.kjv: And by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses.
verses.decoded: Everyone who believes in him is made right with God, something the law of Moses could never do.

verses.kjv: Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken of in the prophets;
verses.decoded: Be careful, or what the prophets warned about might happen to you.

verses.kjv: Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which ye shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you.
verses.decoded: Look, you who reject this message—you will be amazed and destroyed, because I am doing something in your time that you will never believe, even if someone explains it to you.

verses.kjv: And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.
verses.decoded: After the Jews left the synagogue, the Gentiles asked that this message be shared with them again the next Sabbath.

verses.kjv: Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.
verses.decoded: When the meeting ended, many Jews and God-fearing converts followed Paul and Barnabas, who encouraged them to keep trusting in God’s grace.

verses.kjv: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God.
verses.decoded: The next Sabbath, almost the entire city gathered to hear God’s message.

verses.kjv: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming.
verses.decoded: But when the Jews saw the large crowd, they became jealous and spoke against what Paul was saying, opposing and insulting him.

verses.kjv: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.
verses.decoded: Then Paul and Barnabas became confident and said, 'It was right that we first shared God's message with you. But since you have rejected it and judged yourselves unfit for eternal life, we are now turning to the Gentiles.'

verses.kjv: For so hath the Lord commanded us, saying, I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.
verses.decoded: Because the Lord told us, 'I have made you a light for the Gentiles, so that you will bring salvation to the ends of the earth.'

verses.kjv: And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the Lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed.
verses.decoded: When the Gentiles heard this message, they were happy and praised God's word. Many who were meant to have eternal life believed.

verses.kjv: And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region.
verses.decoded: God's message spread throughout the entire area.

verses.kjv: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts.
verses.decoded: But some Jews encouraged the religious and respected women, along with the city leaders, to oppose Paul and Barnabas. They caused trouble and forced them to leave the region.

verses.kjv: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.
verses.decoded: Paul and Barnabas shook the dust off their feet as a sign against them and went to the city of Iconium.

verses.kjv: And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Ghost.
verses.decoded: The followers were filled with joy and the Holy Spirit.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.
verses.decoded: When Paul and Barnabas were in Iconium, they went together to the Jewish synagogue and spoke so effectively that many Jews and Greeks believed.

verses.kjv: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.
verses.decoded: However, some Jews who did not believe stirred up the Gentiles and turned them against the new believers.

verses.kjv: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord, which gave testimony unto the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
verses.decoded: Paul and Barnabas stayed there a long time, boldly speaking about the Lord, who confirmed their message with signs and miracles performed through them.

verses.kjv: But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the Jews, and part with the apostles.
verses.decoded: The people in the city were divided; some sided with the Jews, others with the apostles.

verses.kjv: And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles, and also of the Jews with their rulers, to use them despitefully, and to stone them,
verses.decoded: Then both Gentiles and Jews, along with their leaders, tried to mistreat Paul and Barnabas and even planned to stone them.

verses.kjv: They were ware of it, and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lieth round about:
verses.decoded: When they learned about this, they escaped to the cities of Lystra and Derbe in the Lycaonia region and the surrounding areas.

verses.kjv: And there they preached the gospel.
verses.decoded: There, they preached the good news about Jesus.

verses.kjv: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked:
verses.decoded: In Lystra, a man who had been crippled from birth and could never walk was sitting there.

verses.kjv: The same heard Paul speak: who stedfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,
verses.decoded: He heard Paul speaking, and Paul looked directly at him and saw that he had faith to be healed.

verses.kjv: Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped and walked.
verses.decoded: Paul shouted, 'Stand up on your feet!' The man jumped up and began walking.

verses.kjv: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men.
verses.decoded: When the people saw this miracle, they shouted in their own language, 'The gods have come down to us as humans!'

verses.kjv: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.
verses.decoded: They called Barnabas 'Jupiter' and Paul 'Mercury' because Paul was the main speaker.

verses.kjv: Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.
verses.decoded: The priest of Jupiter, whose temple was near the city, brought oxen and wreaths to the city gates, ready to offer a sacrifice with the crowd.

verses.kjv: Which when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of, they rent their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out,
verses.decoded: When Paul and Barnabas heard this, they tore their clothes in distress and rushed into the crowd, shouting,

verses.kjv: And saying, Sirs, why do ye these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God, which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein:
verses.decoded: They said, 'Friends, why are you doing this? We are just like you, human beings with feelings. We are here to tell you to turn away from these worthless idols and worship the living God, who made the heavens, the earth, the sea, and everything in them.'

verses.kjv: Who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways.
verses.decoded: In the past, God allowed all nations to follow their own paths.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.
verses.decoded: But God did not leave Himself without proof—He did good things, gave rain from heaven, and provided fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and happiness.

verses.kjv: And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people, that they had not done sacrifice unto them.
verses.decoded: With these words, they barely stopped the people from sacrificing to them as gods.

verses.kjv: And there came thither certain Jews from Antioch and Iconium, who persuaded the people, and, having stoned Paul, drew him out of the city, supposing he had been dead.
verses.decoded: Then some Jews from Antioch and Iconium arrived and convinced the people. They stoned Paul and dragged him out of the city, thinking he was dead.

verses.kjv: Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.
verses.decoded: But as the believers gathered around him, Paul got up and went back into the city. The next day, he left with Barnabas for Derbe.

verses.kjv: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,
verses.decoded: After preaching the gospel and teaching many people in that city, they went back to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch, where they made many disciples.

verses.kjv: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.decoded: They encouraged the believers to stay strong in their faith, reminding them that we must go through many hardships to enter God's kingdom.

verses.kjv: And when they had ordained them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed.
verses.decoded: They appointed elders in each church, prayed and fasted, and entrusted them to the Lord, whom they trusted.

verses.kjv: And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.
verses.decoded: After traveling through the region of Pisidia, they arrived in Pamphylia.

verses.kjv: And when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down into Attalia:
verses.decoded: They preached the message in Perga, then traveled down to Attalia.

verses.kjv: And thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled.
verses.decoded: From there, they sailed back to Antioch, the place where they had been entrusted to God's grace for the work they completed.

verses.kjv: And when they were come, and had gathered the church together, they rehearsed all that God had done with them, and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles.
verses.decoded: When they arrived, they gathered the church and told them everything God had done through them, especially how He opened the way for Gentiles to believe.

verses.kjv: And there they abode long time with the disciples.
verses.decoded: They stayed there for a long time with the believers.

verses.kjv: And certain men which came down from Judaea taught the brethren, and said, Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.
verses.decoded: Some men came down from Judea and taught the believers, saying, 'Unless you are circumcised according to the custom of Moses, you cannot be saved.'

verses.kjv: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.
verses.decoded: Paul and Barnabas strongly disagreed and debated with these men, so they decided that Paul, Barnabas, and some others should go to Jerusalem to meet with the apostles and elders to discuss this issue.

verses.kjv: And being brought on their way by the church, they passed through Phenice and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles: and they caused great joy unto all the brethren.
verses.decoded: The church sent them off, and as they traveled through Phoenicia and Samaria, they told people about the Gentiles turning to God, which brought great joy to all the believers.

verses.kjv: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them.
verses.decoded: When they arrived in Jerusalem, the church, apostles, and elders welcomed them, and they reported everything God had done through them.

verses.kjv: But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.
verses.decoded: However, some believing Pharisees stood up and said it was necessary to circumcise the Gentile believers and require them to obey the Law of Moses.

verses.kjv: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter.
verses.decoded: The apostles and elders gathered together to discuss this issue.

verses.kjv: And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men and brethren, ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.
verses.decoded: After much debate, Peter stood up and said, 'Brothers, you know that long ago God chose me to preach the gospel to the Gentiles so they would believe.'

verses.kjv: And God, which knoweth the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Ghost, even as he did unto us;
verses.decoded: God, who knows everyone's heart, confirmed this by giving the Holy Spirit to the Gentiles just as He did to us.

verses.kjv: And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.
verses.decoded: God made no distinction between us and them, cleansing their hearts through faith.

verses.kjv: Now therefore why tempt ye God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
verses.decoded: So why are you testing God by placing a heavy burden on the believers that even our ancestors and we could not bear?

verses.kjv: But we believe that through the grace of the LORD Jesus Christ we shall be saved, even as they.
verses.decoded: We believe that we are saved by the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, just as they are.

verses.kjv: Then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them.
verses.decoded: The whole assembly became silent and listened to Barnabas and Paul as they told about the miracles and wonders God had done among the Gentiles through them.

verses.kjv: And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Men and brethren, hearken unto me:
verses.decoded: After they finished speaking, James spoke up and said, 'Brothers, listen to me.'

verses.kjv: Simeon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.
verses.decoded: Simeon (Peter) has explained how God first visited the Gentiles to take from them a people for His name.

verses.kjv: And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,
verses.decoded: This agrees with what the prophets said, as it is written,

verses.kjv: After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof, and I will set it up:
verses.decoded: After this, I will come back and restore the fallen house of David; I will rebuild its ruins and put it back in place.

verses.kjv: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, saith the Lord, who doeth all these things.
verses.decoded: So that the rest of humanity, including all Gentiles who are called by my name, may seek the Lord, says the Lord, who does these things.

verses.kjv: Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world.
verses.decoded: God has always known everything He has done since the world began.

verses.kjv: Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to God:
verses.decoded: Therefore, my decision is that we should not make things difficult for Gentiles who have turned to God.

verses.kjv: But that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood.
verses.decoded: Instead, we should write to them asking them to avoid food polluted by idols, sexual immorality, meat from strangled animals, and blood.

verses.kjv: For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath day.
verses.decoded: Moses’ teachings have always been preached in every city and are read in the synagogues every Sabbath.

verses.kjv: Then pleased it the apostles and elders, with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; namely, Judas surnamed Barsabas, and Silas, chief men among the brethren:
verses.decoded: The apostles and elders, together with the whole church, decided to send some of their own leaders—Judas called Barsabas and Silas—along with Paul and Barnabas to Antioch.

verses.kjv: And they wrote letters by them after this manner; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia:
verses.decoded: They sent a letter saying: The apostles, elders, and brothers greet the Gentile believers in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia.

verses.kjv: Forasmuch as we have heard, that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words, subverting your souls, saying, Ye must be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no such commandment:
verses.decoded: We heard that some from our group have upset you with their teaching, saying you must be circumcised and follow the law, which we never commanded.

verses.kjv: It seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
verses.decoded: We all agreed to send some chosen men along with our dear friends Barnabas and Paul to you.

verses.kjv: Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.decoded: These men have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell you the same things by mouth.
verses.decoded: We have also sent Judas and Silas, who will verbally confirm the same message to you.

verses.kjv: For it seemed good to the Holy Ghost, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;
verses.decoded: It seemed right to the Holy Spirit and to us not to place any heavier burden on you than these essential requirements.

verses.kjv: That ye abstain from meats offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication: from which if ye keep yourselves, ye shall do well. Fare ye well.
verses.decoded: Avoid eating food sacrificed to idols, blood, meat from strangled animals, and sexual immorality. If you keep yourselves from these, you will do well. Goodbye.

verses.kjv: So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:
verses.decoded: After they were sent off, they arrived in Antioch, gathered the people, and read the letter.

verses.kjv: Which when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.
verses.decoded: When they read it, they were very happy and encouraged.

verses.kjv: And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brethren with many words, and confirmed them.
verses.decoded: Judas and Silas, who were also prophets, encouraged the believers with many words and strengthened their faith.

verses.kjv: And after they had tarried there a space, they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles.
verses.decoded: After staying there for a while, they were sent off peacefully by the believers to return to the apostles.

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still.
verses.decoded: However, Silas decided to stay there longer.

verses.kjv: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
verses.decoded: Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching about the Lord, along with many others.

verses.kjv: And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the LORD, and see how they do.
verses.decoded: After some time, Paul said to Barnabas, 'Let’s visit the believers in all the cities where we preached to check on how they are doing.'

verses.kjv: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.
verses.decoded: Barnabas wanted to take John, also called Mark, with them.

verses.kjv: But Paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.
verses.decoded: But Paul didn’t think it was a good idea to take him because he had left them in Pamphylia and didn’t continue with the work.

verses.kjv: And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus;
verses.decoded: They argued so strongly that they separated. Barnabas took Mark and sailed to Cyprus.

verses.kjv: And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God.
verses.decoded: Paul chose Silas and left, with the believers praying for God’s grace to be with him.

verses.kjv: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches.
verses.decoded: Paul traveled through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the churches there.

verses.kjv: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:
verses.decoded: Then Paul went to Derbe and Lystra. There he found a disciple named Timothy, whose mother was a Jewish believer but whose father was a Greek.

verses.kjv: Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium.
verses.decoded: The believers in Lystra and Iconium spoke well of Timothy.

verses.kjv: Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters: for they knew all that his father was a Greek.
verses.decoded: Paul wanted Timothy to join him on his journey and circumcised him because of the Jewish people living there, since everyone knew Timothy’s father was Greek.

verses.kjv: And as they went through the cities, they delivered them the decrees for to keep, that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: As they traveled from city to city, they gave the people the instructions decided by the apostles and elders in Jerusalem to follow.

verses.kjv: And so were the churches established in the faith, and increased in number daily.
verses.decoded: This helped strengthen the churches in their faith, and their numbers grew every day.

verses.kjv: Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia, and were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia,
verses.decoded: After traveling through Phrygia and Galatia, the Holy Spirit prevented them from preaching in the province of Asia.

verses.kjv: After they were come to Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit suffered them not.
verses.decoded: When they reached Mysia, they tried to enter Bithynia, but the Spirit did not allow them to go there.

verses.kjv: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas.
verses.decoded: So they passed through Mysia and went down to the city of Troas.

verses.kjv: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.
verses.decoded: That night Paul had a vision of a man from Macedonia asking him, 'Come over to Macedonia and help us.'

verses.kjv: And after he had seen the vision, immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia, assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them.
verses.decoded: After seeing the vision, we immediately tried to go to Macedonia, confident that God had called us to preach the gospel there.

verses.kjv: Therefore loosing from Troas, we came with a straight course to Samothracia, and the next day to Neapolis;
verses.decoded: So we left Troas and sailed straight to Samothracia, then the next day to Neapolis.

verses.kjv: And from thence to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia, and a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain days.
verses.decoded: From there we went to Philippi, the main city in that part of Macedonia and a Roman colony. We stayed there for several days.

verses.kjv: And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side, where prayer was wont to be made; and we sat down, and spake unto the women which resorted thither.
verses.decoded: On the Sabbath, we went outside the city to a river where people usually gathered to pray. We sat down and spoke to the women who had come there.

verses.kjv: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.
verses.decoded: A woman named Lydia, a dealer in purple cloth from Thyatira who worshiped God, listened to us. The Lord opened her heart to pay attention to what Paul said.

verses.kjv: And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought us, saying, If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide there. And she constrained us.
verses.decoded: After she and her household were baptized, she invited us, saying, 'If you consider me a believer in the Lord, come and stay at my house.' She persuaded us to accept.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as we went to prayer, a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us, which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying:
verses.decoded: As we were going to pray, a young woman who had a spirit that predicted the future met us. She made a lot of money for her owners by fortune-telling.

verses.kjv: The same followed Paul and us, and cried, saying, These men are the servants of the most high God, which shew unto us the way of salvation.
verses.decoded: She followed Paul and us, shouting, 'These men serve the Most High God and show us how to be saved!'

verses.kjv: And this did she many days. But Paul, being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her. And he came out the same hour.
verses.decoded: She did this for many days. But Paul became upset, turned to the spirit, and said, 'I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to leave her.' The spirit left her immediately.

verses.kjv: And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone, they caught Paul and Silas, and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers,
verses.decoded: When her owners realized they had lost their source of income, they seized Paul and Silas and brought them to the city leaders in the public square.

verses.kjv: And brought them to the magistrates, saying, These men, being Jews, do exceedingly trouble our city,
verses.decoded: They told the magistrates, 'These men are Jews and are causing serious trouble in our city.'

verses.kjv: And teach customs, which are not lawful for us to receive, neither to observe, being Romans.
verses.decoded: They teach customs that are not allowed for us, who are Romans, to follow or accept.

verses.kjv: And the multitude rose up together against them: and the magistrates rent off their clothes, and commanded to beat them.
verses.decoded: The crowd rose up against them. The magistrates tore off their clothes and ordered them to be beaten.

verses.kjv: And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast them into prison, charging the jailor to keep them safely:
verses.decoded: After they had been severely flogged, they were thrown into prison, and the jailer was instructed to keep them securely.

verses.kjv: Who, having received such a charge, thrust them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.
verses.decoded: The jailer, following orders, put them in the inner cell and fastened their feet in stocks.

verses.kjv: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.
verses.decoded: At midnight, Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the other prisoners listened.

verses.kjv: And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one’s bands were loosed.
verses.decoded: Suddenly, a powerful earthquake shook the prison’s foundations. All the doors flew open, and everyone’s chains came loose.

verses.kjv: And the keeper of the prison awaking out of his sleep, and seeing the prison doors open, he drew out his sword, and would have killed himself, supposing that the prisoners had been fled.
verses.decoded: The jailer woke up, saw the prison doors open, drew his sword, and was about to kill himself because he thought the prisoners had escaped.

verses.kjv: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, Do thyself no harm: for we are all here.
verses.decoded: But Paul shouted loudly, 'Don’t harm yourself! We are all here!'

verses.kjv: Then he called for a light, and sprang in, and came trembling, and fell down before Paul and Silas,
verses.decoded: The jailer called for a light, rushed inside trembling, and fell down before Paul and Silas.

verses.kjv: And brought them out, and said, Sirs, what must I do to be saved?
verses.decoded: He brought them outside and asked, 'Sirs, what must I do to be saved?'

verses.kjv: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.
verses.decoded: They said, 'Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved along with everyone in your household.'

verses.kjv: And they spake unto him the word of the Lord, and to all that were in his house.
verses.decoded: They shared the message of the Lord with him and everyone in his home.

verses.kjv: And he took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes; and was baptized, he and all his, straightway.
verses.decoded: At that very hour of the night, he took them and washed their wounds, then he and all his family were immediately baptized.

verses.kjv: And when he had brought them into his house, he set meat before them, and rejoiced, believing in God with all his house.
verses.decoded: After bringing them into his home, he served them food and was filled with joy because he and his whole family believed in God.

verses.kjv: And when it was day, the magistrates sent the serjeants, saying, Let those men go.
verses.decoded: When morning came, the officials sent officers with orders to release Paul and Silas.

verses.kjv: And the keeper of the prison told this saying to Paul, The magistrates have sent to let you go: now therefore depart, and go in peace.
verses.decoded: The jailer told Paul, 'The officials have sent to release you. So now you can leave and go in peace.'

verses.kjv: But Paul said unto them, They have beaten us openly uncondemned, being Romans, and have cast us into prison; and now do they thrust us out privily? nay verily; but let them come themselves and fetch us out.
verses.decoded: But Paul replied, 'They publicly beat us without a trial even though we are Roman citizens and threw us in prison. Now they want to quietly release us? No, let the officials come themselves and escort us out.'

verses.kjv: And the serjeants told these words unto the magistrates: and they feared, when they heard that they were Romans.
verses.decoded: The officers reported Paul's words to the officials, and when they realized Paul and Silas were Roman citizens, they became afraid.

verses.kjv: And they came and besought them, and brought them out, and desired them to depart out of the city.
